contract_semantics.statement: In pure exchange under tax-adjusted natural borrowing, x=a-d maps budget, admissibility, lifetime optimality, invariant laws and bond clearing bijectively between government-debt and debt-free economies. It is not a statement about capital demand or a fixed borrowing cap.
contract_semantics.source_locator: A94 government-debt reinterpretation, printed pp. 673-674 / PDF pp. 16-17.
